scripts.clean: rimraf allure-results/ && rimraf allure-report/ && rimraf mochawesome-report/
scripts.wdio: npm run clean && wdio run wdio.conf.js
scripts.wdio:dev: npm run clean && ENV=dev wdio run wdio.conf.js
scripts.wdio:qa: npm run clean && ENV=qa wdio run wdio.conf.js
scripts.wdio:staging: npm run clean && ENV=staging wdio run wdio.conf.js
scripts.wdio:prod: npm run clean && ENV=prod wdio run wdio.conf.js
scripts.saucelabs: npm run clean && wdio run saucelabs.conf.js
scripts.wdio:api: npm run clean && mocha --recursive test/specs/api/*.js --reporter mochawesome
scripts.wdio:api:dev: npm run clean && ENV=dev mocha --recursive test/specs/api/*.js --reporter mochawesome
scripts.wdio:api:qa: npm run clean && ENV=qa mocha --recursive test/specs/api/*.js --reporter mochawesome
